hints.title: Repeated Heaviest Pair Reduction
hints.text: At each turn, the two heaviest stones are smashed together. The difference in their weights replaces them if they are not identical.

hints.title: Priority Queue Structure
hints.text: Store all stone weights in a max priority structure to efficiently extract the two maximum weights in logarithmic time per smash.

hints.title: Smash Loop Termination
hints.text: While the collection contains more than 1 stone, extract y and x (where y >= x). If y > x, insert y - x back. Return the remaining weight or 0 if empty.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Re-sorting the entire array after each smash takes O(N^2 log N) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A priority queue performs each smash step in O(log N) time, totaling O(N log N).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that a max-heap models repeatedly retrieving the top 2 elements cleanly.
complexity.notes: Standard max-heap implementation using negated keys in Python.
